description: Dashboard (reporting-ui): add a typed getSweepLog() client fn + SweepLogEntry type in lib/api/playerSweep.ts, and a live 'Swept competitions' panel on app/player-sweep/page.tsx showing one row per competition (name, organisation, player count, last-swept date) plus a labelled grand total. Depends on FEAT-001 — the getSweepLog() response mapping MUST match the GET /api/sweep-log field set. Static-export safe plain 'use client' component (Next.js v16); no server code, no new deps.
steps: B1 — reporting-ui/lib/api/playerSweep.ts: reuse the existing module-level WORKER_BASE (NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAYHQ_WORKER_URL — do NOT hardcode). Export `export type SweepLogEntry = { seasonId: string; competitionName: string; organisationName: string; playerCount: number; lastSweptAt: string };`. Add `export async function getSweepLog(): Promise<SweepLogEntry[]>` that does `const res = await fetch(\`${WORKER_BASE}/api/sweep-log\`, { cache: "no-store" });`, `if (!res.ok) throw await errorFrom(res, "Failed loading sweep log");`, then maps the snake_case array to camelCase: `(await res.json() as Array<Record<string, unknown>>).map((r) => ({ seasonId: String(r.season_id ?? ""), competitionName: String(r.competition_name ?? ""), organisationName: String(r.organisation_name ?? ""), playerCount: Number(r.player_count ?? 0), lastSweptAt: String(r.last_swept_at ?? "") }))`.

B2 — reporting-ui/app/player-sweep/page.tsx: add `useEffect` to the react import; import `getSweepLog, type SweepLogEntry` from @/lib/api/playerSweep. In PlayerSweepPage add `const [sweepLog, setSweepLog] = useState<SweepLogEntry[]>([]);` and `const refreshSweepLog = async () => { try { setSweepLog(await getSweepLog()); } catch { /* non-fatal: panel just won't refresh */ } };`. Load on mount: `useEffect(() => { void refreshSweepLog(); }, []);`.

B2 — in onStart's while loop, after a NORMAL (non-throttled) batch is processed (right after setProgress updates the totals), call `await refreshSweepLog();`. After the loop ends (after the final setProgress finalise), call `await refreshSweepLog();` once more. Do NOT refresh on the throttle/retry branch. Do NOT change cursor handling, retry/backoff, error counting, or Stop behavior.

B2 — render a new <section> BELOW the existing sweep <section>: a header card with the grand total = sum of entry.playerCount across rows, labelled e.g. `Players swept across {sweepLog.length} competition{sweepLog.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}` with a sub-note clarifying it is total player-competition memberships (not globally-distinct people). Then a table/list, one row per sweepLog entry: competitionName, organisationName, playerCount, and `new Date(entry.lastSweptAt).toLocaleString()`. Empty state when sweepLog.length === 0: 'No competitions swept yet.' Match the existing dark theme (border-white/10, bg-white/[0.02], text-slate tones; reuse the Stat tile style or the grades table styling). Keep the component 'use client' and static-export safe (no server routes/actions, no generateStaticParams).
acceptance_criteria: getSweepLog() exists, is typed SweepLogEntry[], uses the existing WORKER_BASE (not hardcoded), throws via errorFrom on non-ok, and maps every snake_case field (season_id, competition_name, organisation_name, player_count, last_swept_at) to its camelCase SweepLogEntry field.
The /player-sweep page loads the sweep log on mount, re-fetches after every successful sweep batch and once when the loop ends, so per-competition counts climb live during a sweep.

The panel renders one row per competition (name, organisation, player count, readable last-swept date) with a clearly labelled grand total at the top, and shows 'No competitions swept yet.' when empty.
Existing preview/sweep/retry-backoff/Stop behavior and cursor handling are unchanged; the page remains a plain 'use client' static-export-safe component with no new dependencies.
verification: cd c:\Users\AndyDin\reporting-dashboard\.worktrees\sweep-log\reporting-ui && npm install && npx tsc --noEmit  (no type errors)

Copy c:\Users\AndyDin\reporting-dashboard\reporting-ui\.env and .env.local into the worktree's reporting-ui (or set placeholder NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/ANON_KEY), then `npm run build` — build succeeds and emits out/player-sweep.html. Remove the copied .env files afterward; they must NOT be committed.
findings:
DONE. All FEAT-002 verification passed from the worktree's reporting-ui: `npm install`, `npx tsc --noEmit` (no type errors), `npx vitest --run` (15 files / 195 tests, all pass), and `npm run build` (succeeded, emitted out/player-sweep.html). The /fixtures prerender needed Supabase env as expected — temporarily copied .env + .env.local from c:\Users\AndyDin\reporting-dashboard\reporting-ui, built, then removed both from the worktree (never staged/committed).

B1 (lib/api/playerSweep.ts): added `export type SweepLogEntry = { seasonId; competitionName; organisationName; playerCount; lastSweptAt }` and `export async function getSweepLog(): Promise<SweepLogEntry[]>`. Reuses the existing module-level WORKER_BASE (NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAYHQ_WORKER_URL, not hardcoded), fetches `${WORKER_BASE}/api/sweep-log` with { cache: 'no-store' }, throws via the existing errorFrom(res, 'Failed loading sweep log') on !res.ok, and maps every snake_case field from FEAT-001's contract (season_id, competition_name, organisation_name, player_count, last_swept_at) to camelCase with String()/Number() coercion and ?? fallbacks. FEAT-001 returns a JSON ARRAY ordered last_swept_at desc; mapping matches exactly.

B2 (app/player-sweep/page.tsx): added useEffect to the react import and getSweepLog + type SweepLogEntry to the playerSweep import. Added `sweepLog` state + a non-fatal `refreshSweepLog()` (swallows errors so the panel keeps last-known data), a mount-load `useEffect(() => { void refreshSweepLog(); }, [])`, a `await refreshSweepLog()` after each NORMAL batch's setProgress (not on the throttle/retry branch), and one final `await refreshSweepLog()` after the loop's finalise setProgress. Added a new 'Swept competitions' <section> below the sweep section: a header card with a labelled grand total (sum of playerCount, 'Players swept across N competition(s)') plus a sub-note clarifying it counts player-competition memberships, not globally-distinct people; then a dark-theme table (border-white/10, bg-white/[0.02], text-slate tones) with one row per entry (competitionName, organisationName, right-aligned playerCount, new Date(lastSweptAt).toLocaleString()), and the empty state 'No competitions swept yet.' when sweepLog.length === 0. Component stays a plain 'use client' static-export-safe page — no server routes/handlers/actions, no generateStaticParams, no new dependencies. Existing preview/sweep/retry-backoff/Stop/cursor behavior untouched.
